en: Black‑and‑white postcard view over a tree‑lined foreground towards a historic European town. In the middle distance stands a large Gothic church with two tall, square twin towers capped by small lanterns, dominating the roofscape of closely packed medieval houses and fortification walls. In the lower foreground an industrial brick building with a gabled roof carries a painted sign in German reading "Wagenfabrik v. Gebr. Braese." Smoke rises from a chimney nearby.
